title: Among users who have obtained a “Teacher” badge, identify the user who owns
question: Among users who have obtained a “Teacher” badge, identify the user who owns the post with the highest favorite count, and return this user’s display name, website URL, location, and reputation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055", u."XCL_057", u."XCL_058", u."XCL_053"
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher'
ORDER BY p."XCL_039" DESC
LIMIT 1
